mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS "projectId",scope_sn::integer AS "scopeSn" FROM tb_sy_user_scope WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND proj_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY proj_id,scope_sn
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_sy_accs_log WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.sql: FROM tb_sy_user u WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_user_role ur JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id='ADMIN' AND r.use_yn='Y')
